result.rationale: In the new file, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`, which evaluate to literal property names (the string 'z.string().toString()'), not Zod catch-alls. When credential sharing is enabled, the response's expiry and any extra fields are stripped (or required-key parse fails), so token refresh behavior is broken whenever CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set. The finding's mechanism matches the diff exactly.
